statements.impact_statement: The distribution source enforces authenticated, company-scoped, CEO-safe import preview and import behavior; test evidence: server/src/__tests__/company-portability-routes.test.ts and server/src/__tests__/company-portability.test.ts. The scanner match is caused by the retained upstream package version 0.3.1 rather than the distributed source contents.

Agent key routes resolve the target agent and assert company access before key operations; test evidence: server/src/__tests__/agent-cross-tenant-authz-routes.test.ts. The scanner match is caused by the retained upstream package version 0.3.1 rather than the distributed source contents.

Agent API token creation is company-scoped through the same accessible-agent authorization boundary; test evidence: server/src/__tests__/agent-cross-tenant-authz-routes.test.ts. The scanner match is caused by the retained upstream package version 0.3.1 rather than the distributed source contents.

Agent actors are forbidden from mutating host-executed cleanup commands at all workspace mutation boundaries; test evidence: server/src/__tests__/workspace-runtime-routes-authz.test.ts. The scanner match is caused by the retained upstream package version 0.3.1 rather than the distributed source contents.

Agent actors are forbidden from mutating host-executed provision commands in adapter, project, issue, and runtime configuration; test evidence: server/src/__tests__/workspace-runtime-routes-authz.test.ts. The scanner match is caused by the retained upstream package version 0.3.1 rather than the distributed source contents.

Skill-driven workspace command mutation is governed by the host-command authorization boundary and agent configuration permissions; test evidence: server/src/__tests__/workspace-runtime-routes-authz.test.ts and server/src/__tests__/agent-permissions-routes.test.ts. The scanner match is caused by the retained upstream package version 0.3.1 rather than the distributed source contents.

Authenticated-mode operational endpoints assert board or company access, including heartbeat run reads and cancellation; test evidence: server/src/__tests__/agent-permissions-routes.test.ts and server/src/__tests__/agent-cross-tenant-authz-routes.test.ts. The scanner match is caused by the retained upstream package version 0.3.1 rather than the distributed source contents.

The vulnerable Perl trie path is not on a GLoops control-plane execution path: the production image runs dist/index.js under Node as the unprivileged node user, and exact-digest probes find zero Perl shebangs and zero .pl or .pm application files. Agent actors cannot introduce or mutate host-executed workspace commands; evidence: Dockerfile gloops-production target, exact image sha256:fb63ebfd959890457a5b80728a35a71da267cb18ff4e4f524768c62c9d1ba53d runtime probes, and server/src/__tests__/workspace-runtime-routes-authz.test.ts. A board-authorized arbitrary command already carries explicit shell authority and is outside the untrusted request boundary.

The affected Archive::Tar module is absent from both supported runtime architectures; evidence: exact-image module-load and filesystem probes fail to locate Archive/Tar.pm. The base package scanner reports perl-base because Debian tracks the issue at the perl source-package level.

The affected regex compiler overflow is limited to 32-bit Perl builds, while the release publishes only linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 images; evidence: the release workflow platform declaration and exact-image architecture probe.
